gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p5, GAAP/modified accrual) vs the budgetary comparison schedules (pp12-16, budgetary basis, 'Total resources'). Per fund: General Fund statement total revenues 22,892,527 vs budget schedule 22,724,140 (p12) = 168,387 (e.g. in lieu of tax 4,032,702 vs 4,186,669, franchise 418,538 vs 409,396, charges for services 3,644,493 vs 3,442,319, grants 741,171 vs 662,937, interest 92,242 vs 69,620, intergovernmental 1,778,160 vs 1,762,001, property 5,658,127 vs 5,664,104); Street 4,425,716 vs 4,422,046 (p14) = 3,670 (intergovernmental 3,342,958 vs 3,339,288); Museum 2,022,412 vs 2,027,046 (p15) = -4,634; Debt Service 1,737,491 vs 733,914 (p16) = 1,003,577 (special assessments 1,139,629 vs 134,635, property 446,966 vs 448,382, interest 112,978 vs 112,979); Other Governmental Funds 6,296,845 = nonmajor combining statement columns (pp17-20) 6,296,845, no difference. 168,387 + 3,670 - 4,634 + 1,003,577 = 1,171,000 = the gap. Every printed budget-schedule line is in detail[]; the two printed totals simply differ by basis. No fix.

Statement (p5, GAAP) vs budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis): General Fund total expenditures 20,482,645 vs total charges to appropriations 20,536,321 (pp12-13) = -53,676; Street 3,694,066 vs 3,651,990 (p14) = 42,076 (interest 1,505 vs 2,474, public works 3,245,390 vs 3,202,345); Museum 1,939,650 vs 1,933,893 (p15) = 5,757; Debt Service 463,480 vs 464,373 (p16) = -893 (interest 65,008 vs 65,901); Other Governmental Funds 5,324,878 = nonmajor combining statement (pp17-20) 5,324,878. -53,676 + 42,076 + 5,757 - 893 = -6,736 = the gap. All printed schedule lines are in detail[]; basis difference only. No fix.
